candidates.reason: An empty set is something within a field; absolute Absence explicitly excludes emptiness, zero and missing items.
Existential quantification needs a domain and predicate; Presence is the exhaustive complement of Absence, not a quantified statement.
An unfilled slot can cue an expected item; the containing field and expectation must remain explicit. Also collides with Scope and modal necessity.
Totality does not assert infinite cardinality, duration or accessibility. A universe-of-discourse symbol would also risk replacing Reality with a local domain.
Nonidentity is a close conventional fit. Retain the two Presences or ordered configurations being compared; this is not a numerical difference.
The definition permits ordered associations of more than two participants; a two-way arrow suggests binary symmetry or equivalence.
Expression-to-target direction is useful, but no function, fidelity or causal effect follows. Collides with Transformation; retain a type label.
A compartmented shape can cue constituents considered together. The mathematical squared-plus reading is not the definition; specify Presences and Relations.
A conventional state-variable mnemonic, not a Unicode meaning. Preserve the Configuration and its metalinguistic position; do not create object-level Time.
An oriented edge cues asymmetry. It does not automatically assert causality, transformation, chronology, implication or transitivity.
Input-to-output mapping is a close analogy, but requires States and Direction. Shares its character with Denotation; not a unique token assignment.
Delta cues change, but here the Difference must be joined by a Transformation; subtraction, numerical magnitude and infinitesimals are not implied.
A supplying edge is a visual mnemonic only. Name the supplied parts and account of contribution; it is neither State equality nor complete Causal Contribution.
Use an indexed sequence of Transformations with explicit Feeds joins and shared Direction; one arrow would hide the chain obligations.
Logical implication is not the required matched pair of nonempty causal paths with named upstream Difference and downstream Change.
Equality alone does not name what is preserved or the family of Transformations preserving it.
Preservation across ordered States may be finite; an infinity symbol incorrectly suggests eternity or unlimited duration.
A bar can cue selective gating, but left-tack mathematical readings compete. Retain persistence and both permitted and excluded Transformations.
A diagram node can name a participant, not establish identity. Its Invariant and ordered Persistence witness must remain attached.
The mathematical boundary analogy is useful but partial; this is an identity-indexed Configuration of Constraints, not necessarily a spatial edge or derivative.
Keep the Entity and Boundary indices; a universal outside symbol would erase whose related Presence is excluded from identity.
Approximate equality imports resemblance or fidelity; an expression can denote without either.
A frame can cue the domain of application, but does not specify its members. Collides with Missingness and modal necessity; keep a type label.
A turnstile suggests derivability, not a scoped constructive decision procedure; arbitrary bivalent predicates are insufficient.
A section mark is a mnemonic for an explicit rule, not evidence of one. Legal-document associations must not restrict nonlegal Rules.
Therefore denotes an inferential step, not the required causal trace joining a target to the State containing its Representation.
A reference mark can cue assigned symbolic use; its existing typographic use is not a proof of persistent Denotation under a Rule.
Use an explicit system of Symbols and transformation Rules; neither a letter nor a speech icon expresses persistence and State coordination.
A position indicator cues navigation. Maps also predict or govern and may be nonspatial; selection and distortion remain explicit.
Keep Map plus Scope, Constraints and enumerated distortions. Reusing the Map icon alone would lose the comparison-surface contract.
An incoming edge meeting a bar can cue boundary uptake, not merely a keyboard tab. Retain environmental and internal Differences and the causal path.
A marked internal node is a visual cue, not an eye or truth claim. It must be an internal State produced through Sense, distinct from Attention.
A lined panel cues retained information, but the Representation must persist and refer to an earlier State, Relation or Change.
Retain Record plus the Specification of its Environment-to-Sense causal production; a viewing icon cannot establish that provenance or independence.
An internal Record must be able to condition a later State of the same Entity. A storage icon would erase this operative and identity-bound distinction.
An organized grid can cue structured Representations and Transformations, but not their Perception/Memory-to-later-State joins or adequacy.
An outward edge is a diagram cue, not a compass direction. Show the Entity Boundary and internally originating Causal path.
Name the endpoint Change and originating Action through their Causal path; an implication arrow would erase the mechanism.
Show the Transformation from Perception, Memory or Model to a distinction among available Actions; translation or thought icons import narrower meanings.
Keep Entity plus Interpretation-conditioned Action; a human silhouette would wrongly require humanity and omit the causal condition.
This is the Relation between Interpretation and Action selection or production, not the Agent itself or a generic lightning bolt.
The tool pictograph is mnemonic only: tools need not be manufactured or hand-held. Incorporation into Action must not imply incorporation into identity; presentation can vary.
Modal possibility alone omits the constructive Configuration witness and Constraint-admitted Action-producing path required here.
Use an Entity-indexed scoped set identified by a Specification; merely drawing something inside a circle does not supply the decision procedure.
Show an Interior State crossing the Boundary. Do not reuse Action without preserving its additional internally originating causal-path condition.
A wavy directed line cues repeated similar Transformations, but no liquid, continuity or universal Time is required; persistent Relations must be supplied.
Paired ports cue coordination, but bidirectional exchange is not mandatory. The Boundary and explicitly represented permitted Transformations remain necessary.
An assertion may be false or unsupported; a proof turnstile risks granting derivability before the Agent, Representation and Scope are supplied.
Keep a distinct producer of an Observation bearing on a Claim; an eye icon supplies neither those joins nor independence.
Name available Actions and the exact configure, bypass, determine or prevent relation to a process; a crown or handle hides the Scope and alternatives.
A mathematical precedence order is not the persistent institutional Configuration coordinating a plurality of Agents.
Preserve Order, Rule, Entity, status or Action domain and Scope. A badge would risk adding recording, which is explicitly not required.
A checkmark omits both actual Standing and its exact same-index recording; approval or an unmatched record does not establish Recognition.
Represent the party on whose behalf Actions count, indexed by Order and Standing; a person icon would exclude nonhuman Entities.
A hooked arrow suggests an injection or inclusion, not an Order-recognized Agent-to-Principal relation within Scope.
Institutional counting under an Order and Rule is not identity or unrestricted equivalence; retain recorded status and Scope.
Scales suggest justice, balance or law. Current Authority concerns an Agent's Action counting as binding under an Order, not fairness or the separate physical-conditioning proposal.
Keep a Claim of allowed Actions with Order, Agent, Principal, Scope and interval. Do not encode it as an already valid Permission.
Retain actual Action under Authority submitting both Claim and Specification; a speech icon falsely requires verbal delivery.
Use a typed Declaration with a Permission Claim and exact Authority coverage; a plus sign would hide Principal, Agent, Scope and interval.
A check can cue institutional acceptance, provided Order, Rule, item and purpose stay visible. It is not a Truth, Evidence or Recognition token.
The Record must carry the valid Grant-and-Admission chain and all participants and indices. A green check or key hides the distinction from a Permission Claim.
A barred marker can cue cessation, not Absence or arithmetic division. Keep the authoritative Declaration, Permission and effective time or State.
Represent the actual permitted Agent's Action before Revocation in Scope and interval; Permission alone is not exercise.
Join Permission, Action, time and environmental/technical Constraints to Capability; admission does not guarantee physical feasibility.
Show the Order's operative Rule-to-Constraint/Record/Consequence coupling; a lock or hammer implies a narrower coercive mechanism.
Retain the persistent Order-indexed bundle assigned under Standing; a mask would suggest performance rather than the defined institutional Configuration.
A Rule also needs recorded Specification, purpose, authorizing Declaration and Order. Reusing the Rule mark alone would hide inspectable authorization.
Perpendicularity, logical falsity or probabilistic independence is not the scoped mechanical-and-institutional independence defined here.
Evidence requires an independent Witness and institutional Admission; it can defeat or underdetermine a Claim and need not establish Truth.
Use an indexed evaluation with supporting, defeating or underdetermining disposition; a single positive check would erase two outcomes and the Rule.
Keep the Witness's Claim about Observation or Evidence with identity, Scope, Order and independence Specification; a seal alone does not establish those joins.
A house locates a building, whereas the Order persists through participant changes using Roles, Records, Interfaces and Flows.
A central dot can cue concentration and propagation, but not merely geometric centrality. Keep recurrent Flows and Constraints; no conscious planner is required.
A gear cues specialized recurring function in a larger whole, not necessarily a machine or biological part. Persistence and the larger Entity or Institution must be named; presentation can vary.
Keep the Institution-recognized official Map separate from Reality; a crown or check would imply correctness rather than recognized status.
Partial darkness is not a coordination-required Configuration excluded from the official Map; neither secrecy nor illegality is constitutive.
A human face would collapse institutional Person into a human organism or moral personhood; the definition turns on recorded Standing.
Use a portable Record with exact Action, Agent, Authority, Permission, Scope and observed Consequence; document shape alone is insufficient.
A ruled register cues ordered Records, but their types, producers and Standing remain explicit. No accounting or monetary restriction is intended.
Preserve a plurality of Agents and Institutions enacting and contesting Order; a flag would overidentify the relation with a nation-state.
Name Agency whose Actions transform the defining Order itself; generic change or Authority-backed Action does not preserve this distinction.
Keep the Polity's persistent Capability for Constituent Exercise; no physical power unit or force pictograph captures it.
Use a typed Claim about a separately specified candidate condition with claimant, target and provenance; an awareness icon would assert the underlying condition.
Keep an Order's admitted Attribution and recorded status distinct from both the Claim and the candidate's actual obtainment.
Retain Representation, Rule, Interface, Scope and an actually included Transformation in a Causal path; a play button cannot establish the joins.
Earth-like or direct-sum readings hide participant-relative access. World is a scoped available Configuration, not the whole of Reality or a planet.
A platform shape cues a persistent input source; do not imply inert material. State supply and selective preservation/suppression/amplification require explicit witnesses.
A truth-value constant is not the Claim-indexed semantic Relation and scoped material-adequacy witness; not every Claim is true.
Affection or benevolence is not maintained admission of another's causal contribution under insufficient Control; Trust is not love.
Identity or congruence loses ordered subject/target roles and the chosen constructive correspondence Specification.
Electricity, speed or energy does not establish Model revision and successful Action selection across States not individually enumerated.
Keep the Record/interpreter/Capability causal Configuration and conforming result; a book or truth marker wrongly reduces knowledge to storage or factivity.
Show source and recipient operative Configurations, the mediating Record, causal reconstruction and preserved function; copying a symbol is insufficient.
Add Truth of the exact load-bearing Claim to Operative Knowledge; retain the shared Claim and Scope rather than using a generic check.
Join factive operation to supportive admitted Evidence and independence at the same indices; Truth and warrant must remain distinguishable.
Use a Claim about a separately specified moral condition; no halo or scales should imply actual moral worth or a universal morality.
Keep institutional admission and recorded moral-personhood status distinct from the Attribution and from whether its candidate condition obtains.
Join persistent constituent Capability to actual Order-transforming exercise; a crown would erase realization and Scope.
Keep Standing, Authority and relative maximality under a declared superiority Rule; not absolute power or constituent exercise.
Show Control and Enforcement with both admitted and blocked Transformations and differing Consequences; a fence alone is insufficient.
Preserve the distinct recognizing Order and own-Principal participation, excluding relevant ActsFor dependence; no generic sovereignty emblem preserves this.
A strict preference-order mnemonic is useful, but preserve Agent, Rule and Scope. Do not infer totality, transitivity, revealed choice or numerical utility.
A real-number domain is not a scoped measure Map and need not be its codomain. No Preference correspondence follows; compatibility normalization also folds this to R.
A generic currency sign cues exchange consideration, but Price need not be monetary or establish exchange, utility or moral worth; preserve Ledger and Admission.
A repetition arrow loses Perception, prior Memory, Interpretation of recurrence and the sustaining participant-indexed causal Relation.
Assignment or definition is not ritual-constituted, participant-indexed significance maintained by enactment or operative derived effects.
Keep the scoped Entity-to-constituent-Configuration Relation across States; a bodily silhouette would imply organism shape and a second identity criterion.
Show distinct Organs, recurring Transformations, identity-preserving contributions and inter-Organ feed; a group or enclosure glyph loses the causal join.
Retain internal Model, condition and option Denotations, operative Perception/Memory Differences and the same Body; a viewpoint icon cannot certify them.
Opposed arrows cue outward and return influence, not mere feedback. Label both families, comparison paths, downstream Changes and later return; resembles Interface.
Exclusive-or is a Boolean connective, not a represented-condition-indexed causal determination among available internal Transformations; rejection need not occur.
A focus marker is a useful visual cue, but not vision, accuracy or exhaustive coverage. Preserve directed causal organization across target State changes; resembles Perception and Center.
A heart imports affection or benefit, excluding the approved harmful/interrogative cases; retain Attention and an operative consequence Specification.
Peace or noninterference is not the other's conditions constraining Action. Expressed conditions override defaults and can admit bounded Agency limitation.
